title: Maximum Alternating Subarray Sum
goal: Maximize an alternating sum over a nonempty contiguous subarray.
strategy: Track the best subarray ending here with its last term added or subtracted. A new added state may start at this value or extend a subtracted state; a subtracted state must extend the previous added state.
